title: Lease
description: One scheduler dispatch (Sections 2, 8.4). A lease binds a worker class to one selected move under a fencing token, with a TTL bounding how long a vanished worker can hold the move. The score_snapshot records why this selection was made -- advisory priority only, never a truth value or status change.

worker_class.description: Mirrors commit_gate.vocab.WorkerClass; the explorer role leases as llm-research.

selected_move_id.description: The research-move, formal target or claim this lease dispatches.

route_id.description: Reserved for route-level scheduling (5.11); null until Route objects exist.
